precepts.text: Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear. Your sins is the only thing that separates you from your God. If you doing what you supposed to do, keeping the law of commandments in the faith of Christ, he going to come to you, send you peace, and hear your prayers.
precepts.point: And now we be here praying for you.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

precepts.why:
The prayer asks God to “send you peace, And hear your prayers, and be at one with you, and never forsake you in time of trouble.” You wonder why you have no peace in your life right now, why you are all over the place? Because you are not serving him, not keeping his law and commandments in sincerity. Isaiah shows what keeps us from being one with God.

“Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save.” His hand is not so short that he can’t reach down and help you when you are afflicted or in trouble. “Neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear.” His ear is not so heavy that he can’t hear your prayers and your cries and come down and get you out of that situation.

“But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.” That is what separates you from your God: your sins, your iniquities. That is the only way he separates himself from you, if you are in the midst of sin.

But if you are doing what you are supposed to do, keeping the law of commandments in the faith of Christ, he is going to come to you, send you peace, and hear your prayers. If you are sincere and honest with him, walking right in his sight, waking up and returning to him, he will never forsake you in time of trouble. He will help you through your hard times.

precepts.text: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart. Our people do things with no rhyme or reason. That is being smitten with madness; we have generational curses.
precepts.point: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth. You might say our people are always in the street crying no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is money. They do not want the justice of the Bible. Many of the families of our unjustly slain, we may march with them and support them, but you never see the internal change; they are still celebrating the holidays of the very system they are angry at. They want truth regarding their case, but they do not want God's truth as a whole.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity.” Our hands in the black and brown community are defiled with blood. In Joliet a young man, twenty-three years old, shot to death his own mother, his aunt, his uncle, his bedridden brother and his three sisters, killed another man and shot one more, and then shot himself. That's trauma right there, and the law explains it: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart.”

The Lord shall smite thee with madness: meaning our people are insane. No rhyme, no reason to what they do or why they do it. That's being smitten with madness. We have generational curses. Three teens on a thirty-hour spree of armed robberies and the murder of a churchgoing man; a woman charged with stabbing and killing a three-year-old boy, appearing in court laughing and smiling: that is stricken with madness.

The Bible says, thou shalt not kill, and we are not taught that in church, so some of us grow up with a hateful and murderous spirit on us. No matter how bad, insulting or degrading these videos are, they are filtered through the Bible, showing the stage and state of where we are today, and it is still proof that we are the children of Israel under the curses. The Bible ain't the white man's book. The Bible is our book.

That is why the Lord's hand is not shortened and his ear is not heavy, and still he does not save: “your iniquities have separated between you and your God.”

precepts.text: Here is God's justice: he that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity; he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints. When our people hear what that scripture means, they say, no, we do not want that kind of justice, we want money. That is why they call us hateful for reading it.
precepts.point: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth. You might say our people are always in the street crying no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is money. They do not want the justice of the Bible. Many of the families of our unjustly slain, we may march with them and support them, but you never see the internal change; they are still celebrating the holidays of the very system they are angry at. They want truth regarding their case, but they do not want God's truth as a whole.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth.” You might say, that's not right; our people are in the street all the time crying, no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is called money. They don't want the justice of the Bible. Here is God's justice: “If any man have an ear, let him hear. He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

Now that's justice. And you know what our people say? No, you hate the white man. They know what the scripture means: the one who led into slavery going into slavery, the one who killed with the sword being put to death by the sword. And they say, no, we don't want that kind of justice. We want money, money, money.

That is Isaiah 59:4: none calling for God's justice. They cry for justice in the streets, but when the justice of God is read to them, they call it hateful.

precepts.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face. God's throne is all about justice and judgment; that is exactly what the world does not want.

precepts.why:
“Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.” God's throne is all about justice and judgment. That's exactly what the world doesn't want.

“nor any pleadeth for truth”: they are not pleading for God's truth. The families of our brothers and sisters put to death unjustly, Sandra Bland and the rest, want the truth regarding their case, but they don't want God's truth as a whole. We may march with them and support them, but there is no internal change: they are mad at the white man and still celebrating Christmas and the white man's holidays. “be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.” If I used to celebrate Easter, now I celebrate Passover. They are making a conscious effort not to change.

The Lord is coming with justice and judgment, the habitation of his throne. That is why the world, which cries for justice, will be angry when it comes.

precepts.text: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come. All these nations and religious organizations say they want the Messiah to return, but the Bible prophesies the nations will be angry when he comes, because he is coming with justice and judgment, and many of them are living on stolen land. He will give reward unto his servants the prophets, and to the saints: that reward is power. And he shall destroy them which destroy the earth: they blame the aerosols in our community for the ozone while they send up the rockets, drill out the oil, and drop the missiles. They know who has been destroying the earth, and that is why they will be angry at his return.
precepts.point: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth. You might say our people are always in the street crying no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is money. They do not want the justice of the Bible. Many of the families of our unjustly slain, we may march with them and support them, but you never see the internal change; they are still celebrating the holidays of the very system they are angry at. They want truth regarding their case, but they do not want God's truth as a whole.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
Everybody says, I can't wait until Jesus comes back. Let's see what the Bible says: “And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come.” All these nations, countries and religious organizations say they want the Messiah to return, and the Bible prophesies they will be angry.

Why are they angry? Because “Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne.” The Lord is coming with justice and judgment, and the nations don't want that. Many of those nations are living on stolen land, like America. This is stolen land. They are lying when they say they can't wait. Christ's wrath is coming; he's not coming to hand out lollipops and hugs and kisses.

“and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great.” You know what that reward is? Power. He's going to give his servants power.

“and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.” That's them. They say the aerosols in the black and brown community are destroying the ozone layer, not their rockets and missiles. All that climate change global BS: they are the ones destroying the earth, digging up and sucking out the oil that is meant to lubricate the tectonic plates, and then they wonder why the earthquakes are happening. They know it, and that's why they will be angry at his return. None calleth for the justice of God.

precepts.text: John the Baptist said to the Pharisees and Sadducees, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come? Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance: God's commandments in application are what prove repentance.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
Isaiah 59:5 says “They hatch cockatrice’ eggs”, and a cockatrice is like a poisonous snake. Put together everything from verses two to four, the iniquities that separated us from our God, the hands defiled with blood, the lips that have spoken lies, and this is what comes of it: “he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.” The eggs that are crushed are the kids that come out: a little baby snake. They produce evil followers.

Many years ago at a community meeting a black woman screamed at the police that they were selling drugs in her building and nobody was doing anything. The police set up a sting and locked up two dudes putting drugs in the mailboxes: her own sons. Then she came back saying it was false, with them on video. These are the eggs, the snake eggs coming out.

John the Baptist saw the same thing: “But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers”. That is the same thing Isaiah was talking about. “who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come? Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance”.

A generation of vipers cannot just say it repents. You have to bring forth God's commandments in application; that is what proves your repentance.

precepts.text: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh. Christ called them vipers; John called them vipers; the same serpents Isaiah 59 describes.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
Now Christ is speaking to them: “O generation of vipers”. That goes back to Isaiah 59, the cockatrice' eggs that break out into a viper. Christ called them vipers, and John the Baptist called them vipers. And their children are little snakes too.

“how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.” What is in the heart comes out of the mouth. A generation of vipers cannot speak good things, because what fills their heart is evil.

That is Isaiah 59 again. Before verse 5, verse 3 said our lips have spoken lies and our tongue perverseness. The lips speak lies and the tongue perverseness because the heart is full of iniquity, and the eggs they hatch are the same kind as the ones who laid them.

precepts.text: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts. Our people walk after their own thoughts, and their thoughts are the thoughts these man made religions gave them: do not keep any laws. Those vipers hatch eggs, and little vipers come out.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. See what our people do: they walk after their own thoughts. They don't give a damn what the Bible says; I do what I want to do.

And their thoughts are the white man's thoughts. Our people follow all these man-made religions, and they don't teach God's laws, his commandments, his statutes. We ain't got to keep no laws, because that is what all these white people were teaching: don't keep no laws.

So what do you get? Those vipers hatch eggs, and what comes out? Little vipers, little snakes. Your son, little Tyrone, is a snake, and your daughter, little Chenique, was a snake too. That is what God is saying in Isaiah 59:5, and it is why verse 7 says “their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity”: a rebellious people walking after their own thoughts.

precepts.text: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish: whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web. He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand. Get tangled in that web and the spider comes out to eat you; a house built on it will not endure.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
Isaiah 59 says they “weave the spider’s web” and “Their webs shall not become garments”. Job explains the spider's web. “So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish: Whose hope shall be cut off”, because they are hypocrites, “and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.”

Their trust shall be as a spider's web: you get tangled up in that thing, and that spider comes out and bites you and eats you up.

“He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.” Your house won't stand. A people who forget God weave their webs and lean on what they built, but it cannot cover them or hold them up. That is why Isaiah 59:6 goes on, “neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.”

precepts.text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin: that walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt. At that time it was actual Egypt; today America is the shadow of Egypt, and our people trust in it instead of asking at God's mouth.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
Isaiah 59:6 says “neither shall they cover themselves with their works”, and Isaiah 30 shows the covering they use instead. “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me”: they are looking for counsel, but not from God. “and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”, not according to the Bible, “that they may add sin to sin”.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth”. At that time it was actual Egypt, but today it's America, spiritual Egypt. They have not asked the prophets what the Bible says. They go “to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” America ain't the real Egypt, but it is the shadow of Egypt, and our people trust in it.

That is why the act of violence is in their hands. A cruise line banned passengers for life over a brawl in the buffet; graduation ceremonies break out into fights with families arrested, a day of celebration turned into chaos. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves, following the Democratic or the Republican party, the cross and the white Jesus, and whosoever goes therein shall not know peace.

precepts.text: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee. Isaiah 59 is this curse in real time.
precepts.point: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. And he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: when you repent and come to this truth, everybody around you starts hating you. And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.” We got eyes, but we act like we ain't got none. We act like what we just saw didn't happen. The curse said it would be so: “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.”

We are like blind people, but we have eyes. We see we're not prospering as a people. We see we're under constant oppression as a people. But we act like we don't see it, because oppression has become so normal to us; it's our everyday life.

It's high noon, but in our minds we are so spiritually blind it is like night for us. “we are in desolate places as dead men”: that's the black and brown community, desolate places, our people like the walking dead. Isaiah 59 is Deuteronomy 28:29 in real time.

That is why verse 9 says, “Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us.” We want to live filthy lives, evil lives, violent lives, and then expect justice from God. It don't work like that. Oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.

precepts.text: There is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty: we usually read this as an individual, but think about it as the nation. Yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate, and lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him. The nations are going to marvel when God raises us up, that this low esteemed people now rules the earth.
precepts.point: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. And he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: when you repent and come to this truth, everybody around you starts hating you. And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
There is a difference between being spiritually slow and being spiritually dead. “we are in desolate places as dead men,” but Sirach shows what the nation needs: “Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty.” We usually read it as an individual, but think about it on a bigger scale. You might say this is Joe or Bob. No, this is us.

Slow, needing help, lacking ability, full of poverty: that is our people. “yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,” and lifted up his head from misery, so that many that saw it marvelled at him.

The nations are going to marvel when God raises us up. It will be such a shock that this low, degenerate race of people is now going to rule the earth. We lack the ability now; it is the Lord's eye that sets us up from our low estate.

precepts.text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour. The great house is the nation of Israel, and every school. Sanctuary leaders, you must be able to discern the gold brothers and sisters, the silver, the wood, and the earth. If you have no discernment, you will put people in positions that do not fit them, like Marcus Garvey putting friends over his ships who did not know how to run them, and he lost it all. Shake the friendship appointments; ask who is best qualified. Some brothers and sisters are just slow and need time to grow; fine, then do not put them in that position yet. And purge yourself from the wood and earth spirits that treat this truth like a social club instead of the mustard seed of a government, so you can be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use.
precepts.point: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. And he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: when you repent and come to this truth, everybody around you starts hating you. And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.” The great house is the nation of Israel; think of it as whatever IUIC school you come from. Every camp leader, the head of the sanctuary, must be able to identify the gold brothers and the silver brothers, the gold sisters and silver sisters, and also look through the school and say, this brother and this sister is earth, this one is wood.

If you can't discern that, you'll have problems in the school, putting people in positions that don't fit them. Marcus Garvey had his ships and put his best friends over them, and they didn't know how to run a ship: one crashed, one went to his girlfriend's house, and he lost it all because of friendship. Shake the friendship appointments. Who is best qualified? Who knows what they're doing? A dummy who doesn't study set up as a school leader, and all hell breaks loose. If sanctuary leaders have no discernment, they are spiritually blind and destined for ruin.

Some brothers and sisters are just slow and need more time to grow. Fine; don't put them in that position yet if others are better qualified. “If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.” Purge yourself from the wood and earth spirits. They see this truth not as a government, not as the mustard seed of a government, but as a social club, dancing every new moon and confused when it comes to God's work. That is how a people groping like the blind becomes vessels unto honour.

precepts.text: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already. And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil. For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved. They hate Christ and the commandments because coming to the light reproves the deeds. But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God. We want the word of God to make our deeds manifest: Lord, show me what I am.
precepts.point: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. And he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: when you repent and come to this truth, everybody around you starts hating you. And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
The voices of our people conceive and utter from the heart words of falsehood, lies on top of lies. Christ answers: “He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.” If you believe on the black Messiah, you are not condemned; if you believe not, you're not even keeping commandment one.

“And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.” Christ is that light that came into the world, and men love darkness, sin, rather than light, Christ and keeping the commandments. It didn't change from Isaiah to John; it's the same thing: “we wait for light, but behold obscurity.”

“For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.” They hate Christ, they hate keeping the laws, they hate the commandments, because if you come to Christ your deeds will be reproved: have no other gods before me, bow down to no graven image, remember the Sabbath, honour your father and your mama, thou shalt not kill. They don't want to hear that.

“But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.” We want Christ, the word of God, to make our deeds manifest. What am I? Lord, show me.

precepts.text: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly. That includes some of your own mothers and fathers, brothers and sisters.
precepts.point: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. And he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: when you repent and come to this truth, everybody around you starts hating you. And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.” If you depart from evil by repenting, you make yourself a prey to everybody around you; everybody around you hates your guts now. Amos says the same thing: “They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.”

That includes some of your own mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers. They hate the one who rebukes and abhor the one who speaks uprightly, because “truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.”

“and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.” There was no true judgment in the earth. The one who departs from evil is hated for it, and the Lord sees it.

precepts.text: Joseph of Arimathea, a disciple of Jesus, but secretly. He supported from behind the scenes, and that is better. Christ entered a city and would have no man know it. You tweet your whole life, and it will cost you.
precepts.point: Ye apologized the other day and is back to 250 million dollar tours. When they came for the famous ones in 2016 and 2017, they lost their contracts and endorsements and deleted everything about the movement, which is why we stopped naming who follows us.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
“Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.” If you depart from evil, from the white man's lies, Christianity, Judaism and all that foolishness, you become a target, a prey to the red dragon, the Jewish community and the American government. That is what Christ said this walk is about. So to the celebrities and influential brothers and sisters who watch, Nick Cannon and all of you: don't run out and tell your Jewish friends you are a Black Hebrew Israelite. Reach out, build yourself up, learn how to fight first, and seek counsel from the leaders on how you can be used in this war.

John shows how our people who are rich and famous have to follow this truth: “And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly.” He was a secret follower. He did not put himself out in front; he supported behind the scenes, and that is better.

Remember Kyrie Irving. He didn't announce he was with any group. He sent one tweet, and they annihilated him, fined him, and made him go back and apologize. Ye went and apologized the other day, and now he is back to 250 million dollar tours. When they came for the famous ones in 2016 and 2017, they lost contracts and endorsements and deleted everything about the movement, and that is why we stopped naming who follows us.

The problem with a lot of our people is that we love social media. You tweet your whole life and tell everybody everything, and Christ never said to do that. When he entered a city he would have no man know it, though he could not be hid. Put your whole life out there and it will cost you in the end.

precepts.text: Therefore is judgment far from us; we wait for light but behold obscurity, we grope for the wall like the blind as if we had no eyes, saying some of them are good. We stumble at noon day as in the night, we are in desolate places as dead men, the walking dead; we roar all like bears, crying in the streets, and mourn sore like doves; we look for judgment, but there is none. Our transgressions are multiplied and our sins testify against us. Judgment is turned away backward, justice standeth afar off, truth is fallen in the street, and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: the hangings ruled suicides, the ICE killings, and the boy shot returning a wallet. We had sixty years to do astronomical things and chose twerking instead.
precepts.point: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them. Hosea 5:15: I will go and return to my place till they acknowledge their offence and seek my face; in their affliction they will seek me early. We only cry to the Lord when we are chastised.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

precepts.why:
“Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.” The only time we cry to the Lord is when we are chastised; as Hosea says, “in their affliction they will seek me early.” Isaiah 59 is that cry.

“Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.” Obscurity is confusion. “We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes.” Black people and Latin people act as if we have no eyes. We see the evil, and then we say, some of them are good, they ain't all like that.

“We stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men”: we are like the walking dead. “We roar all like bears”: that is us crying and screaming in the streets, “and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us. For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us.”

“And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.” The judgment we seek in this wicked kingdom is always turned backward, and the truth of God fails out here.

We are watching it on the screen. Young Black men found hanging from trees in Charlotte, Albany, Oakland, Albuquerque, Brookfield, Marietta, and on the campus of Delta State with the back of his head smashed in, every one ruled a suicide with no foul play. Keith Porter shot by an off-duty ICE agent on New Year's Eve; Dr. Linda Davis killed by a driver fleeing ICE. A sixteen-year-old boy in Houston shot on a porch while holding up a wallet he was trying to return, the shooter released, and the boy's family ordered to pay $20,000. No justice, no peace.

We had sixty years of a little liberty that Esau gave us, and we could have done astronomical things, but we dropped the ball. We wanted to sin and be like the other nations, twerking and dancing while the Bible warned us. Now the white man is undoing it, done pretending he is not the devil, and the hangings of the '40s and '50s are starting all over again. So be careful with your children. That is why we cry now: because of our sins.

precepts.text: The righteous live for evermore; there is no death to the righteous, and our brothers and sisters whose bodies returned to dust are coming back. They shall receive a glorious kingdom on earth, New Jerusalem, and a beautiful crown, 2 Esdras 2:42-45. He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour, and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies, the leviathan against the navy; righteousness as a breastplate, true judgment instead of an helmet, holiness for an invincible shield, his severe wrath sharpened for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise. Right-aiming thunderbolts shall fly to the mark, hailstones as in Joshua's day, the sea shall rage and the flood drown them, a mighty wind shall blow them away; thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty. That is what we wait for, preparing our hearts, minds, and souls.
precepts.point: The Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, not all nations. As for me, this is my covenant with them: my spirit that is upon thee, the Holy Spirit, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, the Bible, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor thy seed's seed, from henceforth and for ever.

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth

precepts.why:
Isaiah 59 ends with the Lord seeing “that there was no man”, no intercessor, so his own arm brought salvation: Christ “put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing.” “The Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob”: not all nations. And his covenant is his spirit upon us and his words in our mouth, and in our children's mouths, and our children's children's, for ever. Wisdom of Solomon shows what that Redeemer brings.

“But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord, and the care of them is with the most High.” There is no death to the righteous. If you are in this truth keeping the commandments in the faith of Christ, you live forever; our brothers and sisters whose bodies returned to the dust, those spirits are coming back. We have to believe that.

“Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the Lord’s hand.” The glorious kingdom shall be on earth: that is New Jerusalem. The crown is the one in 2 Esdras 2:42-45: we are going to get crowned with power. “For with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.”

“He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour”: Christ is coming back for war. “And make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies”: that leviathan is going to come out and attack those bastards on the navy. “He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate”, the same as we read in Isaiah 59, “and true judgment instead of an helmet. He shall take holiness for an invincible shield. His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.”

“Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.” Those weapons won't miss; that lightning won't miss. “And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow”, like in the time of Joshua, “and the water of the sea shall rage against them”, tsunamis, “and the floods shall cruelly drown them. Yea, a mighty wind shall stand up against them, and like a storm shall blow them away: thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty.”

That is what we are waiting for: the second coming of Christ. And God would not be just to let the nations off the hook; if he punished his own people, America, England, Japan and Australia will not be unpunished. So while we wait, we must be preparing our hearts, our minds and our souls.

precepts.text: Oppression maketh a wise man mad, and a gift destroyeth the heart.
precepts.point: Leaving the world makes you a target, so fulfil your course and do not fall out.

note.label: Kill Or Be Killed

precepts.why:
“he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey”. The brothers and sisters who depart from evil, keep the laws of God, repent and come back make themselves a target. The ones comfortable in this captivity have their citizenship here; they fully support this demonic system. Why aren't they a target? Solomon shows how they were bought: “Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.”

Surely oppression makes a wise man mad. Does seeing your brothers and sisters in bondage in captivity not make you men mad? So the gift is how they keep the wise from getting mad. It's like the movie Trick Baby: get hold of the ones with the smarts, the understanding and the education first, so they don't go back and cause an uprising among the people. Give them gifts, good jobs, the desires of their heart, the top-of-the-line jobs, so they feel they're not oppressed, and let them know they cannot go back and help heal their communities.

Once you are fully invested in Esau's kingdom, it's a wrap; they have all the hooks. We're not racist; we gave you a good-paying job and a good education; you were able to buy your mom that house. And you are blinded to the oppression of your nation. Then Satan says it's go time. Trump revoked Executive Order 11246 and the affirmative action and DEI orders: I'm doing away with all of that, I'm going to press the hell out of y'all niggas. The highly educated independent woman with the good job, your ass got to go too. A lot of brothers and sisters got fired behind this demon, because they loved the world and received the gift; serving the white man was their pleasure.

Now he shows his fangs. What are you going to do now? The gift destroyed the heart; the one who departs from evil and takes the target on his back has his citizenship in the kingdom.

precepts.text: The works of sinners are works of iniquity; their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood.
precepts.point: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil. Enter not into the path of the wicked; sinners entice, saying come with us, cast in thy lot among us, but walk not thou in the way with them, for their feet run to evil and make haste to shed blood. Many of our young men's lives end short because they follow a multitude to do evil. To be in the midst of the singing, like the whole school hollering fight, fight, fight, is to be in the multitude the Most High warns of; a soul without knowledge of the laws of God hastes with his feet and sins.

note.label: Exodus 23: Righteous Judgment, the Three Feasts, and the Angel of the Covenant

precepts.why:
Isaiah describes the multitude that does evil: “Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.”

“Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.” That is the way the sinners of Proverbs 1 call you into, and the path Proverbs 4 says to turn from. Their feet run to evil, so refrain thy foot from their path.

precepts.text: Your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear; sin and iniquity are what cause the Most High not to hear you, plain and clear.
precepts.point: If you are spiritual, when the Lord ignores you, you understand at that point what it reveals: it is sin. It has to be; the scriptures give only that reason.

note.label: 1 Samuel 14: By Many or by Few

precepts.why:
“But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.” Sin and iniquity are what cause the Most High not to hear you, plain and clear.

So when Saul asked counsel of God and “he answered him not that day”, the silence was the answer: iniquity had separated them from their God.

precepts.text: Behold the Lord's hand is not shortened that it cannot save, but your iniquities have separated between you and your God; that is the problem we face, not that his hand is short. Once we get right as a nation he will fight for us and get a name for himself.
precepts.point: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand. This is why we ask, to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed; his arm is not short, it can save.

note.label: Psalm 20: The Lord Defends His Anointed

precepts.why:
“Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.” This is why we ask, to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed? “Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear”.

His arm is not short; it can save. The problem is on our side: “But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.” That is the problem we face, not that his hand is short.

Once we get right as a nation, he will fight for us and get a name for himself, saving his anointed with the saving strength of his right hand.

precepts.text: Your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid His face from you.
precepts.point: The face is hidden because of iniquity. Sins separate us from the Most High so that He will not hear.

note.label: Psalm 44: We Got Not the Land by Our Own Sword

precepts.why:
“Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?” Isaiah gives the reason the face is hidden: “But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.”

The face is hidden because of iniquity. Sins separate us from the Most High so that he will not hear. That is why the soul is bowed down to the dust and the belly cleaves to the earth: we were once at a higher state and were brought low, and the way back to “Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake” runs through putting away the sins that hid his face.

precepts.text: They make haste to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are iniquity and wasting and destruction are in their paths.
precepts.point: Day and night they go about seeking violence; wickedness is in the midst and deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

note.label: Psalm 55: Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord

precepts.why: “Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.” Day and night they go about the city upon the walls; they make haste to shed innocent blood, their thoughts are iniquity, and wasting and destruction are in their paths. That is the wickedness in the midst of the city, where deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

precepts.text: The Redeemer, referring to Christ, shall come to Zion and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob.
precepts.point: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and to be converted you have to be keeping God's laws, His righteousness. When you forsake the Lord's laws you are consumed together with the sinners.

note.label: Psalm 107: O Give Thanks unto the Lord

precepts.why:
“And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.” The Redeemer is Christ, and he comes to Zion, to Israel.

But notice who in Zion he comes to: “them that turn from transgression in Jacob”. That is the same as being redeemed with judgment and converted with righteousness. The redeemed of the Lord, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy, are those in Jacob who turn from transgression and keep his laws.

Nor out of the mouth of your children, nor out of the mouth of your grandchildren.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: Therefore is judgment far from us: the Bible says judgment is far from our people. We got to understand that. Therefore we cannot be shocked when police do all manner of evil, use unreasonable force, and they say, oh, well, you know, I fear for my life. We can't be shocked when they get off. Stop being shocked. If you shocked, that mean you don't study. Neither doth justice overtake us: we don't know what justice look like. We wait for light, but behold obscurity: we always confused.

note.label: Perilous Times: Judges and Soldiers

points: We grope for the wall like the blind: we blind. We grope in thinking that there's going to be change in democracy. We grope and think, maybe I should be a Republican; we groping over here, maybe I should be a liberal. We think that all these things is going to make a difference. It's not. We stumble at noon day as in the night: the prophets is on the corner saying, this is the way, but our people stumble as in the night. We are in desolate places as dead men: we are the walking dead right in Babylon the Great; spiritually dead.

note.label: Perilous Times: Judges and Soldiers

points: We roar all like bears: that's that civil unrest right there. Hands up, don't shoot. Black lives matter. Say his name. And mourn sore like doves: and that's the heart that we got to have for our people; we always crying. We look for judgment, but there is none: we look for judgment from a crooked system; there is no judgment for us. For salvation, but it is far off from us: somebody to save us from our lowest state.

note.label: Perilous Times: Judges and Soldiers

points: Why is all this happening? For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: we evil as hell. Our people are rotten. So it's going to always be controversy, civil unrest, whether people are innocent or guilty. So we got to use these high controversial moments; we got to use these things to edify people and bring them to Christ and show them the right way.

note.label: Perilous Times: Judges and Soldiers

points: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. Departing from evil is what we read in John: being born again. You wake up to this truth, you say let me serve God, you depart from evil.

You make yourself a target. Not just everyone against you, but the number one enemy: Satan. Once you change your life and you are trying to do right, Satan is coming for you. Here comes the ex you have not seen in five years, hitting you up now that you changed your life. Satan's job is to destroy every last one of us that is born.

note.label: Born for Adversity

points: Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear. They made a play called Your Arms Too Short to Box with God; the Bible says the opposite. God can save us and deliver us whenever he wants.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear. That is the problem right there. It is not that his arm is too short or his ear too heavy; we are not right, and we are not changing our lives. That is the problem with Christianity: they are not trying to transform their lives to that of the nation of Israel according to the holy scriptures.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: Back to Isaiah 59 to walk it down. Why is the Lord not saving us and not hearing our prayers? Your iniquities have separated between you and your God.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. News read in class: a young man in Joliet murdered eight members of his own family before taking his own life; the teaching point is that this is a people stricken with madness and generational curses. News read in class: three teens were arrested in a thirty hour spree of armed robberies and the murder of a churchgoing man. News read in class: a woman charged with killing a three year old boy appeared in court laughing. The Bible says thou shalt not kill, and we are not taught that in church, so some of us grow up with a murderous spirit on us. No matter how bad and degrading these videos are, it is filtered through the Bible, and it is still proof that we are the children of Israel under the curses.

Your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness. A clip was played of a church leader saying we need a third testament because the Bible has become problematic, naming the very scriptures she does not like and saying we should tear those pages out; that is not the word of God, she said, only words about God. That is muttering perverseness while claiming to trust God.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth. You might say our people are always in the street crying no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is money. They do not want the justice of the Bible. Many of the families of our unjustly slain, we may march with them and support them, but you never see the internal change; they are still celebrating the holidays of the very system they are angry at. They want truth regarding their case, but they do not want God's truth as a whole.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web. A cockatrice is a poisonous serpent. Put verses two through four together and this is what comes out of it: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper. The eggs are the children; a generation walking in iniquity produces evil offspring. A story was told of a community meeting where a woman screamed at the police for not stopping the drug dealing in her building; when the sting operation came, the dealers they arrested were her own sons.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands. Clips played: a brawl in a cruise ship buffet that got the passengers banned for life, and high school graduation ceremonies breaking out into fights with families arrested. A day of celebration turned into chaos; that is the act of violence in the hands.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. A clip was played of a man committing a lewd act against an unsuspecting woman in public, and the word compulsion was looked up: an uncontrollable urge to perform an act, driven by an underlying obsessive thought. Pornography exacerbates those thoughts to the point where you cannot control yourself. That is where that road ends if you do not break it.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity. As a result of everything read from verse two down, judgment is far from the negro and the Latino. We want to live evil and violent lives and then expect justice from God. It does not work like that. A clip was recalled of a man boldly declaring that a defendant in a recent murder case would walk free that day, right in front of the flag wearing crowd, and it did not go that way. We wait for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men. We have eyes, but we act like we have none. We see we are not prospering as a people; we see we are under constant oppression; but oppression has become so normal to us that it is just everyday life. We are like the walking dead in desolate places.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: always roaring in the streets for justice, for reparations, for money. We look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us; because we seek salvation the way the white man taught us to seek it.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: and as for our iniquities, we know them. Our people know they are living wrong; they just do not want to be told to their face what their sins are. When we discuss their sins, that is the solution, the same thing a therapist does, except we do it with God's word and we get to the point: you are an adulterer, you are a thief, you are a liar, you are an idolater, and this is the solution. Nobody wants what God says, so they say, I do not want to hear that.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood. Clips played of loud voices among our people conceiving falsehood from the heart: one praising the very organizations that terrorized us because at least they claimed Christ, and another thanking a supposedly unmixed bloodline for producing the Messiah while denying who the people of the book actually are. Words of falsehood on top of falsehood, and Edom hires black voices to use those talking points against the truth.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. And he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: when you repent and come to this truth, everybody around you starts hating you. And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him. The arm is Christ; sit thou at my right hand.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke. He is not coming back for handshakes; he put on the garments of vengeance. According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay: fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies, and to the islands he will repay. And not only the other nations: unrepentant Israelites get the same judgment.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west: prophetically, we are in the west, the western hemisphere. And his glory from the rising of the sun: the eastern hemisphere. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him: he is only going to allow Esau to do but so much.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord. See who he is coming for: them that turn from transgression, because of everything listed from verse two down to verse fifteen. My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

points: Truth faileth, and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. Depart from the lies of Christianity and Judaism and you become a target of the red dragon, the Jewish community, and the government.

A captain to the celebrities and influential brothers and sisters who watch, Nick Cannon included: do not run out announcing you are an Israelite to your Jewish friends. Reach out, build yourself up, learn to fight first, and seek counsel on how to be used in this war. Kyrie Irving sent one tweet and they annihilated him and made him apologize.

Ye apologized the other day and is back to 250 million dollar tours. When they came for the famous ones in 2016 and 2017, they lost their contracts and endorsements and deleted everything about the movement, which is why we stopped naming who follows us.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

points: The Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you. Your hands are defiled with blood, your lips have spoken lies, none calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth; they trust in vanity, democracy, and speak lies, Christianity. Therefore is judgment far from us: the black woman on the news crying no justice for her son, again and again.

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth

points: We grope for the wall like the blind, as if we had no eyes, seeing the death and mockery of our people day after day and acting like we do not; we stumble at noonday, we are in desolate places as dead men, we roar like bears and mourn like doves; we look for judgment and salvation, but it is far off, because of our sins. Our transgressions are multiplied and our sins testify against us: our biggest obstacles when we rebuke the people are Christian black women and effeminate black men who want no commandments. Transgressing and lying against the Lord, speaking oppression and revolt, democracy and Christianity, uttering words of falsehood.

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth

points: Judgment is turned away backward and justice standeth afar off, for truth is fallen in the street; we rally for a family three times, and they go on TV saying they love Christmas and Easter. He that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: repent and your own people hate you, the little white man in their brain. The Lord saw that there was no man and no intercessor, Deuteronomy 28:68, no man shall buy you, so his own arm brought salvation: Christ put on righteousness as a breastplate, an helmet of salvation, the garments of vengeance for clothing, clad with zeal as a cloak. According to their deeds he will repay: fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies, and to the islands; running back to Jamaica or Haiti in your sin will not work, Christ will find you there.

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth
